items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: My name is Floyd Levin, but I'm going to tell you something, Tutti, all these years I never knew.

ctx.x: Buddy Bertrand? And what's your name, the man with the camera over there?

My name is Floyd Levin, but I'm going to tell you something, Tutti, all these years I never knew. My middle name is Bertrand. Would you believe that? I don't know about that. Bertrand, yes, I've kept that a secret. Well, it's, uh...
Uh, well, you got another name too that everybody calls you that you love so... You must love that, huh?
